experience.title: Experience

experience.experience1_desc: I develop and maintain internal and external web applications. I work with Python and Django on the backend, and JavaScript, TypeScript, Vue.js, and React on the frontend. I use PostgreSQL and MySQL for data management, Git for version control, and agile practices with Scrum, Azure, and Jira to organize work and meet goals.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of projects where I apply web development, interface design, and solutions tailored to real needs.
projects.xoxo_description: A social platform built to make user interaction clear, smooth, and adaptable.
projects.xoxo_problem: Create a digital space that centralizes user interaction without sacrificing clarity or ease of use.
projects.xoxo_solution: Built an application with Django and Python, combining an organized backend architecture with a minimalist interface.
projects.xoxo_result: A responsive platform that provides consistent navigation across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
projects.frontend_description: A professional portfolio designed to communicate technical experience, projects, and contact channels through smooth navigation.
projects.frontend_problem: Present professional background, skills, and projects convincingly and accessibly on every device.
projects.frontend_solution: Built an interface with React and TypeScript, using reusable components, responsive design, and deferred section loading.
projects.frontend_result: A public, adaptable site ready to share with recruiters, clients, and collaborators.
projects.backend_description: A backend focused on centralizing portfolio logic and keeping a solid foundation for content management.
projects.backend_problem: Provide a maintainable structure to manage portfolio data, content, and future functionality.
projects.backend_solution: Built the backend with Django and Python, separating business logic from the presentation layer.
projects.backend_result: An organized, extensible foundation for connecting projects, content, and future integrations.
projects.backend_extended_description: This portfolio demonstrates my ability to build complex web applications, prioritizing data integrity and robust business logic through the Python ecosystem.
projects.backend_extended_problem: Manage portfolio information with a secure, easy-to-maintain structure.
projects.backend_extended_solution: Implemented a Django-based backend to organize data and expose business logic.
projects.backend_extended_result: A scalable foundation for connecting portfolio content, projects, and future integrations.
projects.studymax_description: An educational platform designed to support learning and student interaction through rooms and conversations.
projects.studymax_problem: Create a digital space where users could share knowledge and interact in an organized way.
projects.studymax_solution: Built an application with Django and Python, integrating discussion rooms and a dynamic web interface.
projects.studymax_result: A functional educational platform that supports communication, collaboration, and learning among users.
projects.ttravel_description: A travel agency website focused on presenting destinations and services in an engaging, accessible way.
projects.ttravel_problem: Create an engaging web experience to present a travel agency and its different options clearly.
projects.ttravel_solution: Built a modern, responsive interface with JavaScript and Vite, organizing content to make navigation easier.
projects.ttravel_result: An adaptable, visually appealing website for promoting travel services and destinations.
projects.test_task_front_description: A Kanban application for organizing projects and tasks through a visual management system.
projects.test_task_front_problem: Make it easy to organize and track project tasks in a simple, visual way.
projects.test_task_front_solution: Built a Kanban board with React and TypeScript, allowing tasks to be managed and moved between different states.
projects.test_task_front_result: A visual, responsive tool that supports planning, organization, and project-progress tracking.
projects.test_task_back_description: The backend of a Kanban application for managing projects, tasks, and their data in a structured way.
projects.test_task_back_problem: Create a backend foundation capable of managing the data and logic required by a task-management application.
projects.test_task_back_solution: Built the backend with Django and Python, organizing applications, models, and processes to manage system data.
projects.test_task_back_result: A structured backend API ready to support the Kanban board's project- and task-management features.
